title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Judges 2: the angel at Bochim, a generation that did not know Yahweh, and the rise of the judges.

questions.text: From where did Yahweh's angel come up to Bochim?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:1 says Yahweh's angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim.

questions.text: According to the angel, what would the gods of the inhabitants of the land be to Israel?
questions.explanation: In Judges 2:3 the angel says their gods will be a snare to Israel.

questions.text: How did the people respond when the angel spoke these words?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:4 says the people lifted up their voice and wept.

answers.text: They attacked the Canaanites at once
They lifted up their voice and wept

questions.text: Where was Joshua buried, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:9 says they buried him in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim.

questions.text: What is said about the generation that arose after Joshua's generation?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:10 says they didn't know Yahweh, nor the work he had done for Israel.

answers.text: They were stronger than their fathers
They built a temple for Yahweh
They drove out all the nations
They didn't know Yahweh or his work

questions.text: After abandoning Yahweh, whom did Israel serve according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:13 says they abandoned Yahweh and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh raise up to save Israel from those who plundered them?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:16 says Yahweh raised up judges who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

questions.text: Why was Yahweh grieved while a judge was alive?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:18 says it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them.

answers.text: Because the people refused to fight

questions.text: What did the people do when the judge was dead?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:19 says they turned back and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods.

answers.text: They chose a new judge at once
They turned back and dealt more corruptly
They stayed faithful for many years

questions.text: Why did Yahweh leave the nations that Joshua had not driven out?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:22 says Yahweh left them to test Israel, to see if they would keep Yahweh's way.
